statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ is modestly positive late in the thin Labor Day session, while persistent failed-retracement structure remains unverified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; risk is concentrated around the scheduled futures pause and the conditional 22:00 UTC reopen window.
headline: Nasdaq Tail remains below WATCH as a late holiday lift lacks verified one-way structure
body: The latest delayed Investing.com NQ quote captured before the cutoff was 29,620.50 (+0.19%), versus 29,569.75 (+0.02%) in the prior assessment. Fresh Finviz context generated at 13:03 UTC showed delayed NQ +0.03%. The lift is observable, but shallow-pullback or failed-retracement structure is not verified. Brent near $97 and Gulf escalation keep Stress extreme.
